questions.stem:
For the given cell
$\mathrm{Fe^{2+}(eq) + Ag^{+}(aq) \rightarrow Fe^{3+}(aq) + Ag(s)}$
The standard cell potential of the above reaction is
Given :
$\mathrm{Ag^{+} + e^{-} \rightarrow Ag}$ | $E^{0} = x\,\mathrm{V}$
$\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + 2e^{-} \rightarrow Fe}$ | $E^{0} = y\,\mathrm{V}$
$\mathrm{Fe^{3+} + 3e^{-} \rightarrow Fe}$ | $E^{0} = z\,\mathrm{V}$
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{Fe^{2+}(aq) + Ag^{+}(aq) \rightarrow Fe^{3+}(aq) + Ag(s)}$
$\Delta G_{3}^{0} = \Delta G_{1}^{0} + \Delta G_{2}^{0}$
$-3F(-z) = -2F(-y) + \Delta G_{2}^{0}$
$\Delta G_{2}^{0} = 3Fz - 2Fy$
Also $\Delta G_{2}^{0} = -nFE^{0}_{\mathrm{Fe^{+2}/Fe^{+3}}}$
$3Fz - 2Fy = -1F(E^{0}_{\mathrm{Fe^{+2}/Fe^{+3}}})$
$E^{0}_{\mathrm{Fe^{+2}/Fe^{+3}}} = 2y - 3z$
$E^{0}_{\mathrm{cell}}$ for reaction will be
$E^{0}_{\mathrm{Ag^{+}/Ag}} + E^{0}_{\mathrm{Fe^{+2}/Fe^{+3}}}$
$= x + 2y - 3z$
Option (2)

questions.stem: $K_{sp}$ for $\mathrm{Cr(OH)_3}$ is $1.6 \times 10^{-30}$. What is the molar solubility of this salt in water?

$\mathrm{Cr(OH)_{3(s)} \rightleftharpoons Cr^{+3}_{(aq)} + 3OH^{-}_{(aq)}}$
At eq : $s$ | $3s$
$K_{sp} = (s)\cdot(3s)^{3} = 27s^{4}$

questions.stem: Let us consider an endothermic reaction which is non-spontaneous at the freezing point of water. However, the reaction is spontaneous at boiling point of water. Choose the correct option.
questions.solution:
Reaction is spontaneous at relatively high temperature and non-spontaneous at low temperature $\Delta G = \Delta H - T\Delta S$
It is only possible when $\Delta H$ and $\Delta S$ both are positive.
Option (1)

questions.stem:
Which of the following Statements are NOT true about the periodic table?
A. The properties of elements are function of atomic weights.
B. The properties of elements are function of atomic numbers.
C. Elements having similar outer electronic configuration are arranged in same period.
D. An element's location reflects the quantum numbers of the last filled orbital.
E. The number of elements in a period is same as the number of atomic orbitals available in energy level that is being filled.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.solution:
Properties of elements are periodic function of their atomic number. Elements having similar outer electronic configuration are arranged in same group. Number of elements in a period is not equal to number of atomic orbitals available in energy level that is being filled.
Hence, A, C & E are incorrect

questions.stem:
Which of the following statement is true with respect to $\mathrm{H_2O}$, $\mathrm{NH_3}$ and $\mathrm{CH_4}$?
A. The central atoms of all the molecules are $sp^{3}$ hybridized.
B. The H-O-H, H-N-H and H-C-H angles in the above molecules are $104.5^\circ$, $107.5^\circ$ and $109.5^\circ$ respectively.
C. The increasing order of dipole moment is $\mathrm{CH_4 < NH_3 < H_2O}$.
D. Both $\mathrm{H_2O}$ and $\mathrm{NH_3}$ are Lewis acids and $\mathrm{CH_4}$ is a Lewis base.
E. A solution of $\mathrm{NH_3}$ in $\mathrm{H_2O}$ is basic. In this solution $\mathrm{NH_3}$ and $\mathrm{H_2O}$ act as Lowry-Bronsted acid and base respectively.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
Dipole moment $\mathrm{H_2O > NH_3 > CH_4}$
$\mathrm{H_2O}$ & $\mathrm{NH_3}$ are Lewis Bases
$\mathrm{NH_3}$ act as Lowry- Bronsted base
Hence, A, B & C are correct

options.text: A, B, C and E only

questions.stem:
Given below are two statements :
Statement-I : The conversion proceeds well in the less polar medium.
$\mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-Cl \xrightarrow{HO^{-}} CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-OH + Cl^{-}}$
Statement-II : The conversion proceeds well in the more polar medium.
$\mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-Cl \xrightarrow{R_3N} CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-\overset{+}{N}R_3\ Cl^{-}}$
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-Cl + \overset{\ominus}{O}H}$ Reactant (higher charge density) $\xrightarrow{S_N2}$ Transition state (less charge density)
$\Rightarrow$ This reaction will proceed faster in less polar medium which will not increase the activation energy value.
$\mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-Cl + R_3N}$ Reactant (low charge density) $\xrightarrow{S_N2}$ Transition state (Higher charge density)
$\Rightarrow$ This reaction will proceed faster in more polar medium which will decrease the activation energy value.

options.text: Both statement I and statement II are true
Both statement I and statement II are false
Statement I is false but statement II is true
Statement I is true but statement II is false

37.8 g $\mathrm{N_2O_5}$ was taken in a 1 L reaction vessel and allowed to undergo the following reaction at 500 K
$\mathrm{2N_2O_{5(g)} \rightarrow 2N_2O_{4(g)} + O_{2(g)}}$
The total pressure at equilibrium was found to be 18.65 bar.
Then, $K_p$ = _______ $\times 10^{-2}$ [nearest integer]
Assume $\mathrm{N_2O_5}$ to behave ideally under these conditions
Given : $R = 0.082\ \mathrm{bar\,L\,mol^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$
questions.solution:
Initial pressure of $\mathrm{N_2O_5}$
$= \dfrac{\frac{37.8}{108} \times 0.082 \times 500}{1} = 14.35\ \mathrm{bar}$
$\mathrm{2N_2O_5 \rightleftharpoons 2N_2O_4 + O_2}$
$t = 0$ | $14.35$
$t = \mathrm{eq}$ | $14.35 - 2P$ | $2P$ | $P$
$P_{\mathrm{Total}}$ at eqb $= 14.35 + P = 18.65$
$P = 4.3$
$P_{\mathrm{N_2O_5}} = 5.75\ \mathrm{bar}$
$P_{\mathrm{N_2O_4}} = 8.6\ \mathrm{bar}$
$P_{\mathrm{O_2}} = 4.3\ \mathrm{bar}$
$k_p = \dfrac{(8.6)^{2} \times (4.3)}{(5.75)^{2}} = 9.619 = x \times 10^{-2}$
$x = 961.9 \approx 962$

questions.stem:
Standard entropies of $\mathrm{X_2}$, $\mathrm{Y_2}$ and $\mathrm{XY_5}$ are 70, 50 and 110 $\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$ respectively. The temperature in Kelvin at which the reaction
$\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{X_2} + \frac{5}{2}\mathrm{Y_2} \rightarrow \mathrm{XY_5}$  $\Delta H^{\ominus} = -35\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
Will be at equilibrium is ____ (Nearest integer)
questions.solution:
$\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{X_2} + \frac{5}{2}\mathrm{Y_2} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{XY_5}$
$\Delta S^{0}_{\mathrm{Rxn}} = 110 - \left[\left(\frac{1}{2} \times 70\right) + \left(\frac{5}{2} \times 50\right)\right]$
$= 110 - 160 = -50\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$
$\Delta G^{0} = 0$ at eqb
$\Delta G^{0} = \Delta H^{0} - T\Delta S^{0}$
$0 = -35000 - T(-50)$
$T = 700$ Kelvin

Consider the following reaction occurring in the blast furnace.
$\mathrm{Fe_3O_{4(s)} + 4CO_{(g)} \rightarrow 3Fe_{(l)} + 4CO_{2(g)}}$
'$x$' kg of iron is produced when $2.32 \times 10^{3}$ kg $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$ and $2.8 \times 10^{2}$ kg CO are brought together in the furnace. The value of '$x$' is ____. (nearest integer)
{Given :
Molar mass of $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$ = 232 g $\mathrm{mol^{-1}}$
Molar mass of CO = 28 g $\mathrm{mol^{-1}}$
Molar mass of Fe = 56 g $\mathrm{mol^{-1}}$}
questions.solution:
moles of $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4} = \dfrac{2.32 \times 10^{3} \times 10^{3}}{232} = 10000\ \mathrm{mol}$
moles of CO $= \dfrac{2.8 \times 10^{2} \times 10^{3}}{28} = 10000\ \mathrm{mol}$
$\mathrm{Fe_3O_4 + 4CO \longrightarrow 3Fe + 4CO_2}$
$10^{4}$ mol | $10^{4}$ mol
CO is L.R.
mole of Fe $= \dfrac{3}{4} \times 10^{4}$
mass of Fe $= \dfrac{3}{4} \times \dfrac{10^{4} \times 56}{1000}\ \mathrm{kg} = 420\ \mathrm{kg}$
